title: Utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
body:
Kaha Ye Zainab Ne Peet Kar Sar
guloo E Shabbir Per Hai Khanjar
bapa Hai Karbobala Me Mehshar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
1-zameen Per Bikhre Pade Hai Laashe
falak Se Barse Hai Khoon Ke Dhaare
udaasiyo Ke Jahaan Hai Ghere
wahi Hai Tashnalabo Ke Naale
lahu Lahu Hai Ye Saare Manzar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
2-hussain Bhai Lahu Me Tar Hai
na Zeen Par Na Zameen Par Hai magar Bhi Shukr E Khuda Me Sar Hai
kare Na Zibha Ye Mujhko Dar Hai
sawaar Seene Pe Hai Sitamgar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
3-zameen E Karbal Pe Hai Qayamat
ragadte Hai Eideiya Jo Hazrath
sitam Ki Pyase Gale Pe Shiddat
wo Kund Khanjar Ki Hai Aziyyat
juda Hua Mere Bhai Ka Sar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
4-rasul E Akram Ka Hai Nawasa
sitamgaro Ne Hai Jisko Ghera
kahi Se Paththar Kahi Se Bhaalaa
mere Ghareebul Watan Ko Maara
bachalo Aaqa Ko Apne Aakar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
5-hai Ghash Me Aabid Jagaaun Kaise
pidar Ki Haalat Dikhaaun Kaise
mai Haal Ran Ka Sunaaun Kaise
mai Jalte Qaime Bhujaaun Kaise
lo Aai Shaame Ghareeba Ham Par
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
6- Behen Ko Apni Na Yu Rulaao
madad Ko Abbas Jald Aao
jalale Haidar Inhe Dikhaao
sitmagaro Se Hame Bachao
laeen Lete Hai Sar Se Chadar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
7- Tha Jisko Naazo Se Maa Ne Pala
hai Teen Din Ka Wo Bhuka Pyaasa
badan Hai Zakhmo Se Chur Itna
ubalraha Hai Lahu Ka Darya
zameen E Karbobala Hai Muztar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
8-ghire Hai Faujo Me Shaahe Wala
har Ek Jaanib Se Kar Ke Hamla
liye Hai Halqe Me Usko Aada
nahi Hai Koi Bachane Wala
hai Shor Hote Hai Zibha Sarwar
<<MINI>>
utho Kafile Hijab E Zainab
